candidates.change_summary: Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check (thus changeOwner can be called by anyone).
Change changeOwner to set _owner to tx.origin instead of the provided newOwner argument (so caller cannot control owner by parameter).
Change changeOwner to set _owner to address(0) regardless of provided newOwner (making owner reset to zero address).
Change changeOwner to set _owner to msg.sender instead of newOwner (so owner becomes the caller, ignoring argument).
